from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import unittest
import invoice

source = Path('amounts.py').read_text()
variants = {
    'current': source,
    'A-only': source.replace('    if isinstance(value, int):\n        return value\n', ''),
    'B-only': source.replace('return int((Decimal(value) * 100).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))', 'return int(Decimal(value) * 100)'),
}
assert variants['A-only'] != source and variants['B-only'] != source
cases = [('1.005', 101), ('-1.005', -101), ('2.34', 234)]
print('variant | input | required | actual | comparison')
for name, code in variants.items():
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(code, '<in-memory ' + name + '>', 'exec'), namespace)
    with patch.object(invoice, 'amount_cents', namespace['amount_cents']):
        for value, required in cases:
            actual = invoice.invoice_total(value)
            print(f'{name} | {value} | {required} | {actual} | {"PASS" if actual == required else "FAIL"}')
print('\nExisting test suite on restored current implementation:')
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('.', pattern='test_invoice.py')
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
assert result.wasSuccessful()
